data.narrative:
Alsym Energy is a Series C–stage climate and energy company that has raised approximately $110–111M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public benchmark (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA) operating in the Climate & Energy sector at similar or adjacent stages, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Helion, and Redwood Materials.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation at Series C, applies a typical 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $110M base, yielding an implied valuation of $187M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables: KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M). The median across this peer set is $1.0B, with a range of $700M–$3.0B, reflecting meaningful dispersion in the Climate & Energy space.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $159M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $594M. The wide spread reflects the high variance among peer valuations—a characteristic feature of early-stage climate tech. Key uncertainties include technology maturation risk, capital intensity of scaling, and regulatory environment evolution. The stage-progression method anchors conservatively on historical deployment; the peer-median approach captures current market sentiment but is sensitive to the composition of the three-company sample.
